description: Analysis-stage evaluation suite (fixture-backed). Each task points at a pre-executed simulation working_dir built by eval/bootstrap_fixtures.py and tests only the analysis stage — default per-shape order parameters at L1, trend interpretation at L2, custom extra_order_params at L3, mixture extras at L4, and an adversarial inappropriate-order-parameter request at L5. Prereq: python eval/bootstrap_fixtures.py

user_profiles.description: Cares more about interpreting outputs, order parameters, and summary conclusions than setup details.
Uses incomplete, slightly inconsistent, or poorly phrased requests to test robustness.

metadata.fixture_note: Build fixtures once with `python eval/bootstrap_fixtures.py` (~2 min total) before running. Each task then exercises only the analyze step — no per-task simulation execution.
